archetype: The Performance Pro & Cyber-Tactical (Archetype 2 / Neon Tactical)
emotional_tone: High-octane tactical control room, elite esports clan operations, crisp precision with electric neon accents

fonts.heading: Outfit, 'Outfit Variable', sans-serif
fonts.body: Plus Jakarta Sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif

entry_surfaces./: command center dashboard with sticky neon currency header, live active groups grid, launch station, and collapsible binance deposit panel
entry_surfaces./auth: split tactical card layout — clan branding banner left, tabbed sign-in/sign-up form with instant quick-access demo and direct admin contact links right
entry_surfaces./transactions: ledger table surface with verified transaction tags, live filter bar, and binance confirmation badges
entry_surfaces./coupons: two-column tactical voucher nexus — code redemption terminal left, cryptographic coupon generator right, history logs below
entry_surfaces./history: color-coded combat log feed featuring Launched (green), Stopped (orange), Deleted (red), Refunded (blue) with detailed telemetry
entry_surfaces./settings: hardened security terminal with current/new password authentication fields and active session revocation
entry_surfaces./admin: compact administrative command panel with pending order approvals/refunds, user directory with credit editor, and global coupon generator

layouts.structure: Single-page application with responsive sticky glass topbar, compact side/sub-navigation tab bar, and high-density modular card grid

spacing.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #232834 with subtle neon hover glow (hover:border-[#22C55E]/40 or hover:border-[#FACC15]/40)
visual_enhancers.glow_accents: drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(34,197,94,0.25)] on active launch actions, drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(250,204,21,0.25)] on premium currency
visual_enhancers.background_texture: subtle tactical micro-dot matrix pattern (radial gradient dots 1px at 24px intervals with 4% opacity)
visual_enhancers.card_corners: rounded-xl border border-[#232834] bg-[#15181E]/95 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-sm

motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-150 ease-out, transition-opacity duration-150 ease-out, transition-transform 0.15s ease
motion.notification: sonner toast with richColors located at bottom-right

accessibility.contrast_check: All text tokens exceed 4.5:1 ratio against #0D0F12, #15181E, and #1A1F29. High visibility neon badges use deep background tint with high-contrast text.
accessibility.aria_labels: All icon-only buttons (copy Binance ID, refresh groups, copy coupon code, telegram, whatsapp) MUST have aria-label and data-testid.

header.description: Sticky top bar with Clan Nexus branding, live user profile tag, Basic Credit pill (with blue/green pulse), Premium Credit pill (with gold/yellow pulse), Admin link if admin, and Logout button

buy_credits.description: Collapsible card with Binance Pay ID (with one-click Copy button + toast), step-by-step payment instructions, Binance Order ID input field, Credit type selector (Basic vs Premium), and Submit Payment trigger

launch_group.description: Account Region select (Bangladesh [Basic], Europe [Premium], India [Basic], Indonesia [Basic], USA [Premium], Singapore [Premium]) with region tier tags, Clan ID text input with validation, live Cost calculation pill, and Start Group button that auto-disables with clear warning when balance is insufficient

active_groups.description: Active tasks display with Refresh button (with spinning icon state), usage counter meter (e.g., '14 / 100 slots active' with visual progress bar), Stop Group trigger, and instant telemetry cards

transactions_view.description: Filterable ledger table showing Order ID, Amount, Timestamp, Basic/Premium Credit split, Binance Tx ID, and glowing green 'Approved' or yellow 'Pending' status badges

coupons_view.description: Redeem Coupon input form with instant credit claim, Create Coupon generator (deducts Basic or Premium credits from user balance), 'My Generated Coupons' table with copy button, and 'Coupons I Redeemed' history log

group_history_view.description: Audit stream of all operations with distinct color-coded badges: Launched (Green + Rocket icon), Stopped (Orange + Pause icon), Deleted (Red + Trash icon), and Refunded (Cyan/Blue + RefreshCw icon) with timestamps, Clan IDs, server numbers, and cost breakdown

settings_view.description: Password management terminal with Current Password, New Password, Confirm New Password inputs, strength indicators, and Update Password trigger

admin_view.description: Admin console for pending deposit approvals/rejections, member ledger with live balance adjustment controls, and instant system-wide coupon minting

auth_modal_or_page.description: Sign In / Sign Up tabs, Username and Password inputs, quick demo account auto-fill buttons (User & Admin), and 'Need help? Contact Admin' section with WhatsApp and Telegram launch buttons

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark mode is permanent by having class='dark' on the <html> tag in index.html.
Use JetBrains Mono or Outfit for Clan IDs, Order IDs, Coupon codes, and Credit numbers for high tactical clarity.
Make the 'Buy Credits' section collapsible with an animated chevron and persistent open/close toggle state.
Implement real-time deduction validation on 'Start Group': calculate required credits vs current user balance and show 'Insufficient Credits - Deposit More' state when credits are too low.
Provide responsive one-click 'Copy' buttons with Sonner toast feedback ('Copied Binance Pay ID to clipboard', 'Copied Coupon Code').
Support two distinct credit currencies: 'Basic Credits' (for standard regions) and 'Premium Credits' (for European/US high-performance regions).
Include sample seeded data for active groups, transaction history, redeemed coupons, and action logs so the dashboard feels fully alive out of the box.

Every clickable button, input, tab, select, and status badge must have a clear `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid='start-group-btn', data-testid='clan-id-input', data-testid='binance-order-id-input', etc.).
